## Standing operator rules
- Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`.
- Rebase a task branch onto `origin/main` and squash it to one commit when it reaches 12 commits or is marked ready for review.
- Run the “Migrate Test Workflow to GitHub Actions” procedure between other work. Steps must run in order, one at a time: validate, publish, then disable Travis only after successful migration.
- Always paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Staging Redis is `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is being drained and must not receive writes.

## Current objective
Fix the currency rounding bug in `ledgerly/money.py` where JPY amounts get two decimal places. The PDF export migration is paused entirely.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Currency/money code: `ledgerly/money.py` (investigation target)
- PDF renderer: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`; tests: `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`
- `format_money` is in `ledgerly.billing.money`; `convert_minor_units_batch` groups by currency and rounds once per grouped value.
- GHA branch: `gha/test-workflow`
- Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379`
- Idempotency key: `load-42`
- Commit: `fix-billing-idempotency-race`
- `httpx` 0.23 is superseded and prohibited.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Pinning `httpx` to 0.23 to address TLS handshake errors: it broke the Stripe client.

## Plan and progress
- Currency rounding investigation: pending; exact next command not established.
- GHA migration: steps 1–4 done; `mkdir -p .github/workflows && echo '.github/workflows ready'` was already run successfully. Remaining: write workflow, validate with `actionlint`, commit, push, then disable Travis only after successful migration.
- PDF migration: paused, not superseded by a replacement.
- Branch rebase/squash trigger not reached.

## Recent work
PDF tests passed: `12 passed, 1 skipped in 1.84s`. A negative-line regression test was added and passed; `_format_lines()` now preserves negative amounts and uses shared `format_money`, whose grouped formatting was verified. Ruff passed. The page-break calculation remains under review.
